newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Postabank securities Q1 not much hit by bank run.
newsitem.headline: Postabank securities Q1 not much hit by bank run.

text.p: Hungarian securities house Postabank Ertekpapir Rt said on Monday that its turnover in the first quarter of 1997 was not badly hit by a rush by clients to withdraw their deposits from Postabank Rt.
"We did not experience a substantial turn away by clients after that (rush for deposits)," Laszlo Lehoczky, Postabank Securities's Deputy General Director told a news conference.
In the last days of February Postabank, Hungary's second largest commercial bank, was hit by panic withdrawals of over 20 billion forints.
The securities house's turnover amounted to 61 billion forints in January 1997, 56 billion in February, 50 billion in March and a preliminary 56 billion in April, Lehoczky said.
"Postabank Securities is an integral part of the bank...but it is an independent legal entity," he said.

Speaking about Postabank Securities' outlook for 1997, Lehoczky said, it was good but Postabank Securities was not comparable to such major players as ING Barings or ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett "as conditions were different."

In 1996 the securities house boosted turnover in all of the main sectors, and its pre-tax profit rose to 252 million on turnover of 450 billion, up from a pre-tax profit of 69.4 million on turnover of 69 billion in 1995.

"The securities house, like the (Hungarian) securities market had a very dynamic growth in turnover in 1996," Lehoczky said. "The dynamics in turnover characterised all main business areas -- government papers, shares and derivatives."
Postabank Securities' turnover in government papers surged to 350 billion forints in 1996 from 54 billion in 1995, while shares generated a turnover of 25 billion as against seven billion in 1995.

The mushrooming derivatives market, which was launched in 1995 on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE), generated a turnover of 71 billion forints for Postabank Securities in 1996, up from one billion in 1995, Lehoczky said.
Postabank Securities is specialist market maker for the BUX index, twelve-month discount T-bill and one-month BUBOR rate futures on the BSE.
